selected.title: Before the next watering
selected.texas_link: Texas Tech and AgriLife researchers plan crop water-stress trials including a commercial farm near Slaton.

movement.action: published the planned multi-scale water-stress study

selected.why_today: This unused application lead supplies a current fetched primary account and a filmable physical research input. The actual announcement is July 6th, with no October deployment asserted.
selected.consequence: Growers are intended to receive irrigation recommendations from measured crop stress. The illustration distinguishes controlled research water inputs from still-unproven advice and savings.
selected.application_change: The proposed framework would combine different observation scales into tested irrigation recommendations.
selected.counter_image: The closing crop remains separate from an unresolved recommendation and no achieved water savings.
selected.earned_take: Controlling a trial input and proving useful irrigation advice are different steps.

agency.next_step: Researchers develop the database, models and field trials to validate their proposed recommendations.
agency.who_can_act: Researchers and participating growers at the planned trial sites.

filmability.viewer_question: Can a field observation become a useful irrigation recommendation?
filmability.opening_action: Disclosed example: water enters subsurface line below crop roots; same crop row is surveyed
filmability.mechanism: Same field is observed from UAV, ground sensor and satellite; planned ML and crop models combine observations to quantify and predict stress
filmability.human_consequence: Growers are intended to receive timely recommendations; validation precedes any claimed water savings
filmability.source_limit: Development project; no delivered interface, control logic, numeric output or realized savings. Do not equate stress prediction with automatically switching irrigation. Field-day vendor is a separate system.
three_key_images: Same crop area observed at ground/UAV/satellite scales
Recommendation remains provisional beside unchanged field
filmability.strongest_useful_image: Same crop/root section receives controlled water and stays the carried subject through the observation views
filmability.image_leads_to: Which measurement can distinguish a stressed crop from an irrigation assumption?
filmability.missing_picture: Actual algorithm output, delivered recommendation and farmer use are unavailable
filmability.false_inference: The drone opens individual nozzles or the framework has already saved measured water
filmability.alternative_rejected: Observed documentary: inspected photograph is lab drone handling, not field measurement or delivered irrigation result

action_proposals.visible_action: Controlled water enters a buried line below the same crop roots. A paired plot makes the irrigation-condition contrast visible. Ground, airborne and orbital observation views follow the same crop example into a conceptual combined-data comparison, with recommendations and savings unresolved.
action_proposals.consequence: Growers are intended to receive irrigation recommendations from measured crop stress. The illustration distinguishes controlled research water inputs from still-unproven advice and savings.
action_proposals.limits: Generic illustration of the planned Texas Tech and AgriLife study. No actual field, crop measurement, model output, recommendation, irrigation order, yield or achieved water saving is depicted.
action_proposals.source_basis: The full July 6 university article describes subsurface irrigation at planned trial sites, multi-scale observations, a database, models and a decision-support tool. Water conservation is anticipated rather than measured.
